decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying efficient threats. The deck utilizes a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and hand disruption to control the board and disrupt the opponent's resources. It also includes powerful card draw and selection spells to ensure consistency and maintain a high level of interaction. Additionally, the deck features a reanimation package to bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard, further increasing its threat density. The deck's mana base is designed to support its color requirements and includes utility lands for added versatility.

The deck revolves around the interaction between High Tide, Lórien Revealed, and Turnabout to generate large amounts of mana. This mana is then used to cast powerful spells like Time Spiral and Mind's Desire, allowing the player to draw additional cards or potentially win the game. The deck also includes cards like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Merchant Scroll to dig for important combo pieces. Force of Will is included for protection, and Fae of Wishes and Cunning Wish provide additional versatility with the ability to tutor for specific spells in the sideboard. Candelabra of Tawnos helps further with mana generation.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand, using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting. It then uses reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring those creatures back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo finish. The deck also includes disruption cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own strategy. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures from the graveyard.

This deck focuses on using Cascade cards such as Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst to generate card advantage and overwhelm the opponent quickly. Utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Lórien Revealed to further cascade triggers. The deck also includes disruption with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, as well as tempo plays with Brazen Borrower and Fire/Ice. The inclusion of mana acceleration with Simian Spirit Guide and Elvish Spirit Guide allows for explosive starts. Additionally, the deck runs land destruction with Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bringing them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also utilizes cards like Entomb and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect your own creatures. The deck uses a combination of efficient mana acceleration with cards like Dark Ritual and Urza's Saga to quickly set up its combo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through various counter spells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering key spells, removing threats from the board, and generating card advantage with cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Brainstorm. The deck also utilizes alternate win conditions such as Leyline Binding and Orcish Bowmasters to further control the game. Through a combination of control elements and versatile threats, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in order to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board control. The deck utilizes a mix of blue, white, and green cards to address a wide range of threats, while also incorporating powerful creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath for added value. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage and efficiently answering threats, ultimately grinding out a win through attrition and resource management.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. The main win condition is using The One Ring to lock down the opponent's resources while generating incremental advantage. Utilizing cards like Swords to Plowshares, Brainstorm, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan allows the deck to establish board control and grind out victories. The mana base is designed to support a variety of colors necessary for casting the spells in the deck, ensuring consistency in controlling the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Grist, the Hunger Tide to overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy involves ramping up mana quickly with cards like Gaea's Cradle and Natural Order, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with control elements like Endurance and Boseiju, Who Endures. The deck also has a toolbox aspect with Fiend Artisan and Green Sun's Zenith, allowing for flexibility in finding key creatures. Overall, the deck aims to control the game until it can establish a dominant board presence and win through powerful creature attacks.

The key concept of this Grixis Aggro Legacy deck is to use cheap and efficient spells like Ponder, Lightning Bolt, and Delver of Secrets to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. The deck also utilizes disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide powerful threats that can quickly close out the game. Wasteland is used to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while Mishra's Bauble provides additional card selection. The deck aims to win the game quickly through aggressive plays and efficient spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand using cards like Faithless Looting, Entomb, and Grief. The goal is to then use reanimation spells such as Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a quick win. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. This deck aims to combo off efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful reanimation strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to deal fast and consistent damage to the opponent using burn spells and aggressive creatures. It aims to apply pressure early in the game with cards like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, while also punishing the opponent for playing non-basic lands with Price of Progress. The deck also features efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast to close out the game quickly. Eidolon of the Great Revel and Sulfuric Vortex are included to further disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from stabilizing.

The deck focuses on playing powerful creatures quickly and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Solitude and Archon of Emeria. It aims to gain advantage by taking the initiative in the game and putting pressure on the opponent with efficient threats. The use of cards like Chalice of the Void and City of Traitors allows for explosive plays and efficient mana ramp. The deck also includes some card draw and protection options like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Karakas. Overall, the deck is built to be fast, disruptive, and aggressive in order to seize control of the game.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Narset, Parter of Veils and Shark Typhoon to generate value and close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Mystic Sanctuary and Brainstorm allows for consistency and flexibility in the deck's game plan, while also providing the deck with resilience against various strategies.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Fury. The deck aims to control the game early on by locking down the opponent's resources with cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere, allowing the player to quickly close out the game with their powerful threats. The focus is on quickly establishing a dominant board presence and overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by countering and removing opponents' threats, while also generating card advantage through spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Snapcaster Mage. The deck utilizes a mix of efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as counterspells such as Force of Will and Counterspell. It also utilizes card selection and manipulation with Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistent draws. The deck's win conditions include controlling the board with cards like Terminus and Back to Basics, and finishing the game with powerful threats like Monastery Mentor and Entreat the Angels.
